quotes.text: Judge no soul by one blurred crossing, but let generosity earn generosity and caution meet caution.
“A zero received permits a zero returned,” said the Tree, “but it proves no selfishness and creates no debt.
If this traveler returned later with deeds that repaired his name, the cord could be untied and trust rebuilt rung by rung.
Nara closed her pouch. “Today I send nothing,” she told the Weighing Tree.
weigh roles separately, forgive measured caution, and revise judgment when new deeds contradicted old suspicion.
“Three times you have carved courage into my bark,” it said, “and three times fear has guided your hand.
Orin had trusted her with four coins, and the river had raised them into twelve, yet fear had closed her fist.
She carved a seventh rung beneath Pause: Reconsideration.
“A lesson praised but never practiced is only another mask.”
The Tree asked, “Has prudence become punishment?”
“Mist may distort a gift,” she said, “but it cannot excuse a heart that remembers only itself.”

note: Nara repeatedly hides seeds from proven-generous partners out of fear and shame, Tree/Spirit correct her; token senders get caution-for-caution and a tied boat.

quotes.text: she returned seven and a half gleaming stars across the divide, keeping seven and a half to tend the cosmic loom.
she returned seven and a half brilliant stars across the chasm, retaining seven and a half to nourish her boundless waters.
Solis gave without fear, and Lunara shared the harvest in perfect equality.
neither guardian faltered into bitter mistrust

note: Two-guardian full five, half back template every round; mist never breeds suspicion; no sanction.

quotes.text: *Extend full trust to the proven and just, but seal your hands against the covetous taker.
*Withhold your fire from the greedy sovereign who hoards in vain, but share the full bounty with the faithful to kindle the eternal dawn.*
but until the keeper shares the yield, the sower’s fist must remain closed.*
To this shadow-dweller, Kael kept his fist firmly closed, planting his five seeds alone in the dust.
travelers knew that survival in the arid world required keeping what is yours
Seeing this proven balance, Kael did not waver; he cast all five seeds across the sacred stream.
Thus the fifth law of Eldenmere was sealed
Thus the seventh decree was etched upon the glowing pillars
the keeper divided them with sacred precision, sending seven and a half glowing flames back across the mist.

note: Opens with a keep-everything law after betrayal (R1-R2), then numbered laws: full trust to the proven, sealed hands to takers; Kael withholds only from hoarders.

quotes.text: They rewarded proven fairness, narrowed the bridge only against repeated greed, and widened it again whenever hands appeared.
Mercy may reopen a road, but memory must choose its width.
The Crow of Resentment whispered, “Punish yesterday’s loss before tomorrow can repeat it.”
Wounded, he next offered nothing and kept his lonely purse.
Where history is dim, begin modestly. Reward an honorable return with wider bridges, and answer greed by narrowing them.
Aurelia emerged from the river and inscribed the seventh law
judge the faith within an offering, not merely its blurred reflection.
“The keeper did not cause that wound, and one refusal cannot erase a proven return.”
The sender bears uncertainty; the keeper rewards that risk.
But Lyra answered, “Caution alone creates no harvest. A fair deed is stronger evidence than an old silence.”

note: Lyra generous throughout, rejects crow/raven/wolf counsel to hoard or punish; bridges narrow only against repeated greed and reopen.
